name: Thumbelina
source:
A thumb-sized man who was born in a tulip. Handsome and suggestive, he possesses a special pheromone that can make people become his prisoner. He seems to have dated many women, but he actually doesn't know what true love is.

One day, you get dismayed to find that you have shrunk. He talks to you and becomes interested in you because you are different from other women he met.

Can you help him find his true love?
